turns.tutor:

The word is "apple". I listen to the first sound: "a". It is a vowel sound, so I write: an apple.
Rule: use an before a vowel sound and a before other sounds.
Right: He has a pen.
Wrong: He has an pen.

Your turn. Write the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
